s-cbe8bdbc58cd5f5e.signature: class Projection final:public runtime::IObservationEpochProjection { runtime::EpochRuntimeProjectionPort delegate_; std::array<runtime::SourcePermission,runtime::kMaxSources> sources_{}; std::size_t count_=0; bool ensure(std::uint32_t source,std::uint32_t clock)noexcept { for(std::size_t i=0;i<count_;++i)if(sources_[i].source==source)return sources_[i].clock_domain==clock; if(count_==sources_.size())return false; const runtime::SourcePermission permission{source,clock,runtime::Origin::simulated,true,true,true,0}; if(!delegate_.enroll(permission))return false; sources_[count_++]=permission;return true; } public: explicit Projection(runtime::IObservationRuntime& runtime)noexcept:delegate_(runtime){} bool enroll(runtime::SourcePermission)noexcept override{return false;} bool prepare(const runtime::Observation& observation)noexcept { return runtime::valid_observation(observation)&&observation.origin==runtime::Origin::simulated&& ensure(observation.source,observation.clock_domain)&&delegate_.can_accept(observation); } bool can_accept(const runtime::Observation& observation)const noexcept override{return delegate_.can_accept(observation);} bool apply(const runtime::Observation& observation)noexcept override { return observation.origin==runtime::Origin::simulated&&ensure(observation.source,observation.clock_domain)&&delegate_.apply(observation); } runtime::ColonyState latest()const noexcept override{return delegate_.latest();} bool restore(const runtime::ColonyState& state)noexcept override { if(state.sources>runtime::kMaxSources)return false; for(std::size_t i=0;i<state.sources;++i)if(!ensure(state.cursors[i].id,state.cursors[i].clock_domain))return false; return delegate_.restore(state); } }
